name: rag_reindex
description: Wipe the existing index and rebuild from scratch. Heavier than rag_index — only use when the index is structurally stale (chunker/embedder change, schema migration, etc.). Runs asynchronously via N8N.

parameters.name: target_path
parameters.description: Workspace root to rebuild against. Defaults to $WYLDE_WORKSPACE_ROOT or the current working directory.
